title: Blow-Up Criteria and Weak--Strong Uniqueness for Compressible Fluid--Viscoelastic Shell Interactions
summary: Existence and uniqueness of strong solutions to a barotropic compressible fluid--viscoelastic shell interaction system have recently been established on a finite time interval. A natural question is whether such solutions can be continued globally. In this work, we derive a continuation criterion for this coupled system. Our analysis is based on an energy estimate at the level of material acceleration, derived under Serrin-type and Beale--Kato--Majda-type control assumptions.
